chandasamādhi.p: [Chanda+adhipati+samādhi] (pu) CL=10 Term adhipati is elided.] Concentration that has chanda as the chief - that makes chanda its chief. (a) Concentration that arises - that is caused to arise - that is acquired depending on chanda - by making chanda the chief - leader. (b) Concentration that has chanda as the cause - that arises because of chanda. (c) Concentration that has excessive chanda - of which the chanda is excessive. (2) Concentration that combines with - is together with chandādhipati. See also - chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgata.
